CustomField.description: The destination when the indicator is clicked: a URL or a Screen Flow API name. Both support {!Field_API_Name} merge tokens resolved from the current record at click time.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: A URL (for URL action type) or Screen Flow API name (for Flow Modal). Supports {!Field_API_Name} merge tokens replaced at click time with the record's field values (e.g. /{!AccountId}/view).
CustomField.label: Action Target
